title: PME v1.6 — Professional Typographic Identity
scope: Local typography refinement. Separate from PME-V1.6-CALENDAR.

git.worktree: original; isolated original HEAD archive used only for comparison
git.generatedPublicGithubTimestamps: restored to initial content after builds

coverage.note: Full upstream asset, not subset. Non-Latin quoted names and symbol/arrow characters use existing system fallbacks; no script font is replaced.

browser.expectedDifferenceReason: Light-theme paragraph contrast and largest-text grid/word reflow fixes. Normal dark, large and CJK writing-mode samples are identical.

contrast.limitation: Bounded sampled contrast review of the selected semantic section text in six static reduced-motion Chrome layouts. It is not a complete WCAG audit, screen-reader review, all text coverage, or proof of every possible animated pixel. Rectangle sampling is conservative: it includes spaces between actual glyph strokes. Screenshots preserve original layout, canvas, button backgrounds and borders; text, text shadows and text decorations alone are suppressed.

performance.method: Five alternating original/final local Chrome cold-context navigations, 1440x1000, reduced motion, no network/CPU throttling; other QA finished. Local transfer includes response headers. Descriptive samples, not a production significance test.
performance.interpretation: Local median LCP increased 120 ms (520 to 640 ms), with overlapping 476–660 / 504–828 ms ranges. Five unthrottled local samples do not establish statistical significance or a production LCP gate. Maximum CLS rose to 0.00066015. Review the measured trade-off before release; no claim of unchanged LCP. No typography JS or application JS byte increase. One 49,256-byte display asset for Latin entries; zero new display resources for initial non-Latin entries.
performance.reproduce: QA_MODULES_DIR=/path/to/node_modules node scripts/typography-performance-qa.mjs (same sequential sampling method as recorded audit; run after all other suites)
